items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: Well, Ridgely did Tra-la-la, and Dave and I did it, and leased it to Decca Records.

ctx.x: Tough to do business with. He had a guy, his lawyer, Jack Pearl. Mm-hmm, right. You know, Jack Pearl was one of the big heavies in the industry at that time.

Yeah, I'm telling you, Jack Pearl, if you signed the contract Jack Pearl wrote for him, you were in trouble. I mean, you, for instance, just remember, for instance. I may have told you this earlier, but Tommy Ridgely's Tina Na, not Tina Na, what was it we did with Tommy Ridgely? It was one of the first things. It was a hit. Tra-la-la? Tra-la-la. Right. Tra-la-la. Well, Ridgely did Tra-la-la, and Dave and I did it, and leased it to Decca Records.
